name: WISE J184125.47+095436.5
note: A star that NASA's WISE telescope flagged as variable years earlier. Can SPHEREx see it change?

text.summary: WISE J184125.47+095436.5 faded by 0.66 magnitudes between September 2025 and September 2026. This star was previously flagged as variable by NASA's WISE telescope, and SPHEREx is now observing it for further changes.

items.text: The target faded by a brightness ratio of 1.84 and was double-checked against nearby stars at matching colours.
